notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Izzet Boilerworks.
Izzet Boilerworks does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Izzet Boilerworks.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Izzet Boilerworks to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding one mana of the chosen color.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Repeat.
